example.config:
# Cloudflare Tunnel ingress for the UM cloud share API.
#
# This file is the public edge contract (D18-1): only the four shared API
# paths are routed to the loopback 8100 gateway.  The private management
# console, the share backend and the display are NEVER published here; the
# catch-all answers 404 for every other path.
#
# Install with `install.sh --with-cloudflared` (default off).  The tunnel token
# lives in /etc/um-share/cloudflared.env, not in this file.
ingress:
  - hostname: dacintapi.de5.net
    path: ^/v1/models$
    service: http://127.0.0.1:8003
  - hostname: dacintapi.de5.net
    path: ^/v1/chat/completions$
    service: http://127.0.0.1:8003
  - hostname: dacintapi.de5.net
    path: ^/v1/messages$
    service: http://127.0.0.1:8003
  - hostname: dacintapi.de5.net
    path: ^/v1/responses$
    service: http://127.0.0.1:8003
  - service: http_status:404

assembly.brokerEnv:
# Broker host environment.  Installed as /etc/um-share/broker.env (0640
# root:um-share).  UM_SHARE_UID is appended by install.sh; do not put a
# different numeric uid here by hand.
UM_SHARE_HOST_STATE_DIR=/run/um-share
UM_SHARE_GATEWAY_PORT=8100
UM_DRAIN_BUDGET_S=900
UM_BROKER_DRAIN_MAX_S=90
# The 8100 gateway persists its revoke nonces and applied generations here.
# The broker unit runs ProtectSystem=strict and only /var/lib/um-share is
# writable, so this must NOT point inside the release tree
# (/opt/um-share/current).  install.sh appends this key to an existing
# broker.env; keep both in sync.  The gateway adopts a pre-fix
# <release>/data/share-revoke.state once at its first start, so an upgrade
# does not drop a pending security-journal generation.
CHAT2API_SHARE_REVOKE_STATE_FILE=/var/lib/um-share/share-revoke.state

assembly.brokerUnit:
[Unit]
Description=UM share broker host (single authority for the 8100 child)
Documentation=file:///opt/um-share/current/um-cloud-deploy/README.md
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
ConditionPathExists=/opt/um-share/current/share/broker_ops.py
ConditionPathExists=/etc/um-share/broker-control.key

[Service]
Type=simple
User=um-share
Group=um-share
WorkingDirectory=/opt/um-share/current
EnvironmentFile=/etc/um-share/broker.env
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/um-share/console.env
# The merged 8100 child keeps the console's token/profile under the writable
# console state, never inside the read-only release.  The environment file also
# carries these on an installed host; the explicit values keep the broker child
# correct even when the optional console.env predates the merged process.
Environment=CHAT2API_TOKEN_FILE=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/token.json
Environment=CHAT2API_PROFILE_DIR=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/edge-profile
Environment=CHAT2API_SERVICE_LOG=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/share-backend.log
Environment=CHAT2API_USAGE_LOG=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/usage-share-backend.jsonl
Environment=CHAT2API_CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE=/etc/um-share/admin-control-token
EnvironmentFile=-/etc/um-share/console.env
Environment=CHAT2API_CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE=/etc/um-share/admin-control-token
# The browser launch gets these only when the on-demand display is active;
# the default headless path never connects to them.  browser_login also
# injects the display's published values, so a changed display path does not
# require a broker restart.
Environment=DISPLAY=:99
Environment=XAUTHORITY=/run/um-share/display.auth
# The 8100 gateway persists its revoke state under the state directory, never
# inside the release: ProtectSystem=strict keeps /opt/um-share/current read-only.
# install.sh appends
# CHAT2API_SHARE_REVOKE_STATE_FILE=/var/lib/um-share/share-revoke.state
# to broker.env, and the 8100 child inherits this EnvironmentFile.
# The gateway child runs as a script (sys.path[0]=chat2api); the shared
# projection parser lives one level up at the release root.
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/opt/um-share/current
UMask=0077
# Fail the START, never silently run without metering: broker.env must set
# UM_SHARE_UID.
ExecStartPre=/opt/um-share/venv/bin/python /opt/um-share/current/um-cloud-deploy/backup_restore.py --check-deployment-assembly broker /etc/systemd/system/um-share-broker.service /etc/um-share/broker.env
ExecStart=/opt/um-share/venv/bin/python /opt/um-share/current/share/broker_ops.py \
  --socket-path /run/um-share/broker.sock \
  --key-file /etc/um-share/broker-control.key \
  --instance-key-file /etc/um-share/instance.key \
  --registration-file /var/lib/um-share/run/instance-registration.json \
  --instance-socket-prefix /run/um-share/instance- \
  --projection-path /var/lib/um-share/run/share-projection.json \
  --broker-dir /var/lib/um-share/broker \
  --host-pid-file /run/um-share/share-gateway.pid \
  --state-dir /run/um-share \
  --expected-uid ${UM_SHARE_UID} \
  --expect-instance-image /opt/um-share/venv/bin/python \
  --expect-instance-cmdline-marker chat2api.py \
  --expect-instance-port 8100 \
  --host-command /opt/um-share/venv/bin/python /opt/um-share/current/chat2api/chat2api.py \
    --port 8100 \
    --base-url https://chat.genai.um.edu.mo \
    --login-timeout 1800 \
    --share-config /var/lib/um-share/run/share-projection.json \
    --auth-mode projection \
    --instance-key-file /etc/um-share/instance.key \
    --instance-pipe-prefix /run/um-share/instance- \
    --registration-file /var/lib/um-share/run/instance-registration.json
# The broker host owns the ONLY Popen that starts chat2api.py.  The
# console unit is fenced with InaccessiblePaths for the same script, so a
# console "service.start" can never become a second launcher.
# The broker creates its AF_UNIX socket asynchronously after ExecStart, so an
# immediate start races it and answers not_installed.  Wait up to 10 s
# (50 x 0.2 s) for the socket, then retry the restricted start; success
# exits 0.  The leading "-" keeps the broker unit active when a persisted
# stop intent correctly refuses the automatic start; an operator start uses
# `brokerctl start-explicit`.
ExecStartPost=-/bin/sh -c 'i=0; while [ $$i -lt 50 ]; do \
  if [ -S /run/um-share/broker.sock ] && \
     /opt/um-share/bin/um-share-brokerctl.py start; then exit 0; fi; \
  i=$$((i+1)); sleep 0.2; done; exit 1'
# A 15-minute total drain is enforced by the helper: wait for ESTABLISHED
# connections to 8100 to reach zero, then send the broker drain verb (its own
# bounded in-flight wait + final stop + closure verification).  A timed-out
# update never switches the current symlink.
ExecStop=/opt/um-share/bin/um-share-brokerctl.py --drain-budget ${UM_DRAIN_BUDGET_S} --poll-interval 5 stop
TimeoutStartSec=120
TimeoutStopSec=960
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
KillMode=control-group
# The 8100 child is spawned with start_new_session=True but stays in this
# service cgroup: control-group is the final cleanup fence.
LimitNOFILE=65536
TasksMax=512
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true
LockPersonality=true
RestrictRealtime=true
RemoveIPC=true
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
StateDirectory=um-share
StateDirectoryMode=0750
RuntimeDirectory=um-share
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
# The display unit keeps its Xvfb auth cookie under /run/um-share.  Without
# preserve, this unit's stop wipes the directory out from under the RUNNING Xvfb
# and the login window dies with "(EE) Failed to open authorization file".
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
LogsDirectory=um-share
LogsDirectoryMode=0750
ConfigurationDirectory=um-share
ConfigurationDirectoryMode=0750
# /var/lib/um-share is the persistent state fence (StateDirectory=um-share);
# the 8100 gateway's revoke state lives there.  Do not widen this to the
# release tree: /opt/um-share/current must stay read-only at runtime.
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/um-share /run/um-share /var/log/um-share

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

assembly.env:
# Console (8096) environment.  Installed as /etc/um-share/console.env
# (0640 root:um-share).  UM_SHARE_UID is appended by install.sh.
# Expand-contract (2026-11-14): the cloud console moved 18096 -> 8096.  The
# legacy 18096 remains an accepted explicit USAGESRV_PORT for one release
# cycle; the next release removes the alias.
UM_SHARE_ROLE=cloud
UM_SHARE_DEPLOYMENT=cloud
BASE_URL=https://chat.genai.um.edu.mo
USAGESRV_PORT=8096
USAGE_CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE=/etc/um-share/admin-control-token
USAGE_SESSION_CODE_FILE=/var/lib/um-share-console/session-code
CONSOLE_STATE_FILE=/var/lib/um-share-console/console-state.sqlite3
CONSOLE_LOCK_DIR=/var/lib/um-share-console/console-locks
SHARE_STORE_FILE=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-store.db
# POSIX share-key encryption key (AES-GCM).  Persistent deployment state, not
# release material: the product default <release>/data/share-secret.key would
# vanish when `current` switches releases.  install.sh creates it 0600
# um-share:um-share and never overwrites it.
CHAT2API_SHARE_SECRET_KEY_FILE=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-secret.key
SHARE_MANAGEMENT_CONFIG=/etc/um-share/share-management.json
CONSOLE_SHARE_BACKEND_DIR=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend
# The merged 8100 child owns the UM login token and browser profile; keep them
# in the writable console state instead of the read-only release.
CHAT2API_TOKEN_FILE=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/token.json
CHAT2API_PROFILE_DIR=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/edge-profile
CHAT2API_USAGE_LOG=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/usage-share-backend.jsonl
CHAT2API_SERVICE_LOG=/var/lib/um-share-console/share-backend/share-backend.log
CONSOLE_SHARE_RUN_ROOT=/var/lib/um-share-console
UM_SHARE_GATEWAY_PID_FILE=/run/um-share/share-gateway.pid
UM_SHARE_HOST_STATE_DIR=/run/um-share
UM_SHARE_GATEWAY_PORT=8100
# Optional private Tailscale Serve policy: exact ts.net HTTPS origin, owner and
# concrete PC/phone device IPs.  The file is root-readable only and never in Git;
# missing or invalid policy leaves remote access closed while 127.0.0.1 stays local.
USAGE_TAILNET_CONFIG_FILE=/etc/um-share/console-tailnet-access.json
# Private web login window.  The display unit is installed but NOT enabled, and
# the normal headless login does not need it.  When a manual takeover is
# required, run display/manual-takeover.sh start: it starts the unit for this
# boot (never enables it) and turns this surface on.  The noVNC page and
# WebSocket proxy are same-origin under /display/; x11vnc stays 127.0.0.1:8097.
# Expand-contract (2026-11-14): the display moved 5901 -> 8097.  The legacy
# 5901 remains an accepted explicit CONSOLE_DISPLAY_VNC_PORT for one release
# cycle; the display start script reads this line so both sides keep the same port.
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_ENABLED=0
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_VNC_HOST=127.0.0.1
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_VNC_PORT=8097
# The display service answers VNC challenges on this private Unix socket.
# The console proxy sends only 16-byte challenges and receives 16-byte
# responses; it never reads the VNC password and never forwards it to a browser.
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_VNC_AUTH_SOCKET=/run/um-share/vnc-auth.sock
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_NOVNC_ROOT=/usr/share/novnc
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_LAUNCHER_FILE=/opt/um-share/current/um-cloud-deploy/display/novnc-launcher.html
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_MAX_CONNECTIONS=2
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_IDLE_TIMEOUT=900
CONSOLE_DISPLAY_MAX_SESSION=14400
# Public API origin shown by the console and used by the public probe.  Missing
# means "not configured"; the probe then keeps the legacy .ts.net rule.
CONSOLE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://dacintapi.de5.net
# Playwright Chromium executable resolved by install.sh from the installed
# browser tree.  A stale or non-executable path is a configuration error.
CHAT2API_BROWSER_PATH=/opt/um-share/pw-browsers/chromium-1248/chrome-linux64/chrome
# The cloud share does not add an extra per-key dispatch queue.
CHAT2API_SHARE_DISPATCH_MAX_WAIT_S=0
# Cloud-ops read face (usagesrv.cloud_ops_status).  Only the independent
# security journal remains; budget and automatic backup status are no longer part
# of the deployment.
UM_CLOUD_SECURITY_STATE=/var/lib/um-share/security-state.json
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/um-share/pw-browsers
HOME=/var/lib/um-share-console

[Unit]
Description=UM share console (loopback 8096)
Documentation=file:///opt/um-share/current/um-cloud-deploy/README.md
After=network-online.target um-share-broker.service
Wants=network-online.target
ConditionPathExists=/opt/um-share/current/usagesrv.py

[Service]
Type=simple
User=um-share
Group=um-share
WorkingDirectory=/opt/um-share/current
EnvironmentFile=/etc/um-share/console.env
UMask=0077
# Fail the START when console.env no longer wires the security read face: an
# unconfigured console must not look like a healthy one.
ExecStartPre=/opt/um-share/venv/bin/python /opt/um-share/current/um-cloud-deploy/backup_restore.py --check-deployment-assembly console /etc/systemd/system/um-share-console.service /etc/um-share/console.env
ExecStart=/opt/um-share/venv/bin/python /opt/um-share/current/usagesrv.py
# Single-authority fence: the console may READ the broker pid/intent for
# status, but it may not write /run/um-share (ReadOnlyPaths) and it may not
# execute chat2api.py directly (NoExecPaths).  A console service.start
# therefore cannot spawn a second 8100; it fails before a live gateway exists.
# The console never starts a second share process: the broker owns the only
# Popen.  The merged 8100 process re-reads the projection file itself.
ReadOnlyPaths=-/run/um-share
InaccessiblePaths=
NoExecPaths=-/opt/um-share/current/chat2api/chat2api.py
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/um-share-console /var/log/um-share-console

TimeoutStopSec=120
Restart=on-failure

NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ProtectKernelTunables=true
ProtectKernelModules=true
ProtectControlGroups=true
RestrictSUIDSGID=true

RestrictRealtime=true
